verdict.rationale: Snyk's DeepCode AI documentation explicitly states it supports 'context-aware risk scoring, assessing the popularity of the affected package and the reachability of vulnerable code' (snyk-docs-36), directly addressing reachability-based prioritization, and Snyk Code offers risk scoring incorporating prevalence and ease of fix (snyk-docs-4). However, this reachability capability is described only briefly and tied to DeepCode AI/Code rather than clearly extended to Snyk Open Source (dependency/SCA) alerts specifically, and there is no independent or hands-on evidence confirming reachability analysis works reliably in practice for dependency vulnerabilities. missing for 10: explicit documentation that reachability analysis applies to Snyk Open Source (SCA) alerts specifically (not just SAST/DeepCode), independent/hands-on verification of reachability accuracy, and detail on how reachability signals surface in the alert triage UI/workflow.
